Name: Batteries Not Included
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Let's face facts here.... the late game is a grind. You have chests full of ore, stacks of geodes you don't have the patience to crack, and you are constantly running out of Coal. Batteries not Included introduces a new, higher level of tech that will let you abandon Coal entirely and replaces it with a fully battery based system. The better the battery you use, the more product you get.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

[list]
[list]
[*]A New multi-tier battery system. Adding 2 new styles of batteries, the Chemical battery and the Fusion Cell
[*]Several new "electric" machines replacing the machines whose vanilla counterparts use coal to operate
[/list]
New Recipes:
[Spoiler]

Electric Furnace
Recipe: 1 Furnace + 5 Battery Packs
Unlock: Mining Level 6
Electric Crusher
Recipe: 1 Geode Crusher + 5 Battery Packs
Unlock: Mining Level 7
Electric Smoker
Recipe: 1 Fish Smoker + 2 Battery Packs + 10 Refined Quartz
Unlock: Fishing Level 6
Bio-Vat
Recipe: 20 Slime + 5 Copper Bars + 10 Refined Quartz
Unlock: Farming Level 5
BNI Centrifuge
Recipe: 5 Iridium Bars + 2 Radioactive Bars + 10 Battery Packs
Unlock: Mining Level 9
Chemical Battery
Machine: Bio-Vat
Input: 50 Slime + 20 Sap
Time: 4 Hours
Fusion Cell
Machine: Centrifuge
Input: 1 Battery Pack + 5 Solar Essence + 1 iridum bar
Time: 24 Hours
